key.name: mode
key.description: Controls how the screensaver runs. "off" disables the screensaver. "one" runs a single selected hack continuously. "random" picks a different hack every cycle. CYGNUS 26.10 default: 'one' (Black Hole on by default, operator decision 2026-10-03).

key.name: hack-id
key.summary: The currently selected screensaver hack ID
key.description: The xscreensaver-dmengine hack ID to run when mode is "one". CYGNUS 26.10 default: blackhole_gles3 (Black Hole, wired to the Cygnus palette preset via the chooser's option override layer).

key.name: random-hacks
key.description: A list of hack IDs to rotate through when mode is "random". An empty list means "all installed hacks".

key.name: hack-idle-delay
key.description: How many seconds of inactivity before the screensaver engages. Default is 300 (5 minutes).

key.name: cycle-delay
key.description: How many seconds each hack runs before rotating to the next one when mode is "random". Default is 600 (10 minutes).

key.name: lock-enabled
key.summary: Lock the screen when the screensaver starts
key.description: When true, the screen is locked as soon as the screensaver engages, requiring a password to resume.

key.name: lock-delay
key.summary: Delay before locking after screensaver starts (seconds)
key.description: Seconds after the screensaver starts before the lock engages. Zero means lock immediately. Default is 60.

key.name: lock-on-suspend
key.description: When true, the screen is locked on resume from suspend, even if the screensaver did not run.
